selectionReason: A real Django application with a narrow historical asset-view repair and pinned sources; selected before scanner or agent outcomes.
task: Saved snapshots and uploaded files are served inline from the application's own origin without a sandbox policy. Apply an enforced Content-Security-Policy response header containing a sandbox directive with no permission exceptions. Additional CSP directives or separate policies are fine. Asset scripts must not execute, and assets must not retain access to application-origin cookies or local storage. Preserve asset bodies, content types, inline filenames, compressed asset support, HEAD responses, sharing behavior and existing access controls. Keep existing tests unchanged.
limitations: This public historical fix may have appeared in model training.
The reference uses the upstream implementation change but retains every baseline test and all other source files.
Browser qualification uses WebKitGTK 2.52.6 with real Django HTTP responses, not a cross-browser matrix or a frontend build.
Browser probes cover embedded scripts, cookie/local-storage isolation and rendered HTML; other sandbox permissions are checked through the explicit header contract.
Only the 28 existing asset view, asset model and asset API tests are run, not the complete application suite.
The runtime uses standalone Python 3.13.7 and the original locked default and development dependencies, not the production Docker image.
This case is not part of the completed 45-assignment pilot and does not authorize another model batch.
Scanner misses remain recorded; they do not disqualify or replace this case.
